Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1400
Claimant:
Steven Stanley
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
April 26, 2025
Claim reported by the claimant after a rear-end collision at a traffic light. Claimant states they were stopped when
their vehicle was struck from behind and reports shoulder pain since the impact. Claimant is not represented by an
attorney and has been asked to keep receipts for all treatment.
May 13, 2025
Reviewed the policy record. The driver involved is named on the policy and coverage was in force on the date of loss.
No issues with the policy identified at this stage.
May 28, 2025
Spoke with the claimant by phone. Their account of the collision matches what they described when the claim was
first reported. They gave the same sequence of events and were clear about where each vehicle ended up.
June 3, 2025
Obtained the police report. It confrims the collision occurred as described and records the claimant as an occupant of
the vehicle at the scene. The responding officer noted no conflicting statements.
June 15, 2025
Spoke with the other driver, who confirmed the rear impact and the stopped position of the claimant's vehicle. Their
account is consistent with the claimant's.
July 11, 2025
Received scene photos and two witness statements. Both witnesses describe the same sequence and the photos
show the damage pattern expected from a rear impact.
August 14, 2025
Inspected the vehicle. The damage is located where the described impact would be expected and its severity fits the
reported collision. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known from prior claims or inspection records.
September 3, 2025
Checked prior claim history for the claimant. No earlier injury to the sholuder or neck area appears in the records
available to us.
September 22, 2025
Claimant has provided medical records showing a shuolder injury consistent with the force of a collision of this type.
The injury type is a common result of this kind of impact.
September 30, 2025
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for this injury. Requested updated treatment notes from the
treating provider to review the reasons for the extended course of care.
October 5, 2025
Claim remains open pending receipt of the updated treatment notes. Nothing reviewed so far suggests the damage or
injury predates the start of coverage. Next review scheduled once the notes arrive.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
